title: Strengthen owner-scoped encrypted desktop authorization and WebRTC lifecycle safeguards.
changes: Refuse desktop-control and screen-sensitive AI tools under E2EE read-only grants even when a runtime accidentally reports permissive readOnlyHint metadata and the peer allowlist is misconfigured.
Keep per-peer explicit authorization and device-local consent for control-mode desktop input; retain owner revocation, session fencing, idempotent native Stop and fail-closed reconnection guards.
Extend encrypted control and WebRTC cancellation/race regression coverage on ASUS, plus source-only Windows and macOS QA evidence; do not activate production remote control.
Clarify that WebRTC media uses DTLS-SRTP and is not claimed to provide separately audited HPKE application-layer media encryption.
